# Design point P022

## Description

Replicas use conditional object-store metadata checks to verify freshness before serving repository reads, while pushes and other fundamental operations are processed in a single consistent order. The freshness check supports read correctness, but by itself does not establish the ordering or acknowledgment behavior for writes.
